	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	username VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	password_hash VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	institucio VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	role VARCHAR, 
	active BOOLEAN, 
	versio_sessio INTEGER DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME, 
	updated_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (username)
)

CREATE TABLE abreviatures_grups (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	grups_originals VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	abreviatura VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME, 
	updated_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (grups_originals)
)

CREATE TABLE alliberaments_periode (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	tipus VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	clau VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	dia_setmana VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	hora VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	des_de DATE NOT NULL, 
	alliberat BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE aules (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	codi VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	nom VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	tipus VARCHAR, 
	capacitat INTEGER, 
	ordre INTEGER, 
	activa BOOLEAN, 
	created_at DATETIME, 
	updated_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (codi)
)

CREATE TABLE categories_prioritat (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	nom VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	ordre INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	activa BOOLEAN, 
	created_at DATETIME, 
	updated_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (ordre)
)

CREATE TABLE configuracio (
	clau VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	valor TEXT, 
	tipus VARCHAR, 
	descripcio TEXT, 
	updated_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (clau)
)

CREATE TABLE configuracio_examens (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	assignatura VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	grup VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	titular VARCHAR, 
	aula VARCHAR, 
	ordre INTEGER, 
	created_at DATETIME, 
	updated_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE cursos (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	nom VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	data_inici DATE NOT NULL, 
	data_fi DATE, 
	created_at DATETIME, 
	updated_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE exam_costos_professors (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	professor VARCHAR, 
	tipus VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	pes INTEGER, 
	created_at DATETIME, 
	updated_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE exam_pesos_optimitzacio (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	clau VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	valor INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	descripcio TEXT, 
	updated_at DATETIME, 
	created_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (clau)
)

CREATE TABLE exam_preferencies (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	tipus VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	assignatures TEXT NOT NULL, 
	pes INTEGER, 
	activa BOOLEAN, 
	created_at DATETIME, 
	updated_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE exam_restriccions (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	tipus VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	clau VARCHAR, 
	configuracio TEXT, 
	pes INTEGER, 
	activa BOOLEAN, 
	created_at DATETIME, 
	updated_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE grups_alliberats (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	data DATE NOT NULL, 
	hora VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	grups VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME, 
	updated_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE grups_amagats (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	grup VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (grup)
)

CREATE TABLE nivells (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	codi VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	nom VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	ordre INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	actiu BOOLEAN, 
	created_at DATETIME, 
	updated_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (codi)
)

CREATE TABLE no_substituir (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	assignatura VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME, 
	updated_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (assignatura)
)

CREATE TABLE professors (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	nom VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	actiu BOOLEAN, 
	primera_aparicio DATE, 
	ultima_aparicio DATE, 
	created_at DATETIME, 
	updated_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (nom)
)

CREATE TABLE professors_baixa (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	professor VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	data_inici DATE NOT NULL, 
	data_final DATE NOT NULL, 
	motiu VARCHAR, 
	created_at DATETIME, 
	updated_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE propostes_descartades (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	assignatura VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	grup VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	titular VARCHAR, 
	created_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE substitucions (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	data DATE NOT NULL, 
	hora VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	professor_absent VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	assignatura VARCHAR, 
	grup VARCHAR, 
	aula VARCHAR, 
	substitut VARCHAR, 
	tipus_substitut VARCHAR, 
	tipus_absencia VARCHAR, 
	comentaris TEXT, 
	created_at DATETIME, 
	updated_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE vigilancies (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	data DATE NOT NULL, 
	hora VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	tipus VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	grups VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	aula VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	vigilant VARCHAR, 
	comentaris TEXT, 
	nivell VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	ordre INTEGER, 
	created_at DATETIME, 
	updated_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE xml_versions (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	path VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	data_inici DATE NOT NULL, 
	data_fi DATE, 
	hash_contingut VARCHAR, 
	created_at DATETIME, 
	updated_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE assignatures (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	nom VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	nivell_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	ordre INTEGER, 
	activa BOOLEAN, 
	created_at DATETIME, 
	updated_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(nivell_id) REFERENCES nivells (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE assignatures_prioritat (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	assignatura VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	categoria_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	pes INTEGER, 
	ordre INTEGER, 
	auto_assignada BOOLEAN, 
	created_at DATETIME, 
	updated_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(categoria_id) REFERENCES categories_prioritat (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE grups (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	codi VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	nom VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	nivell_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	es_combinat BOOLEAN, 
	grups_components TEXT, 
	ordre INTEGER, 
	actiu BOOLEAN, 
	created_at DATETIME, 
	updated_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (codi), 
	FOREIGN KEY(nivell_id) REFERENCES nivells (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
